request: 신규 연구 전 과정 검증 및 실제 테스트

prior_failure_audit.method: Label-free remeasurement using the unchanged candidate and frozen Discovery input against current live APPROVED Gold

new_research.selection_basis: Outcome-free definition index: source present, no same-name trial; change in annual sales growth rather than sales-growth level or a window-only variation
new_research.pre_evaluation_adjustments: Attach a hypothesis-specific v2 diagnostic plan and monthly rebalance contract before any registration or return evaluation; keep the existing formula and sign
new_research.reference_limit: Revenue-news persistence is background motivation, not validation of this TTM growth-acceleration formula or an exact revenue-surprise replication
new_research.run_condition: Current data authentication, input feasibility, novelty and all unchanged registration gates must pass

stages: Authenticate live Silver and preserve original failure evidence
Freeze one candidate, monthly contract, diagnostics, code, data and reviewed-memory usage
Register and evaluate Discovery once only if all preflight gates pass
Run actual HOST_LLM diagnostic choices and explicit terminal decision
Finalize the original campaign; SQL parity and one-time OOS only if automatically qualified
Prepare factual lesson draft and independent critic review
Activate accepted qualitative memory and verify scoped retrieval
success_definition: A recorded full actual research workflow, including rejection if warranted; not a promise of factor approval or causal identification
